# User Management: Staff Types and Access

**User Management** is where you add your team to OrderHub and decide what each person can do. Before you add anybody, it helps to know that OrderHub has two quite different kinds of staff, and that a person's role decides what they can see and touch.

You'll find it at **Settings → User Management** (*Manage users, roles, and permissions*). Only an Organization Admin can make changes here.

---

## The two kinds of staff

When you press **Add Staff** you choose between two routes, and the choice matters.

**Staff with an OrderHub login**
For managers, office staff and anyone who needs OrderHub on a computer. They need an email address and sign in with a 6-digit code sent to that email. They can also be given till access on top.

**POS-only staff**
For counter staff who only use OrderHub POS at the till. No email address, no web login — their card shows *No email (PIN login)* and they sign in at the till with a 4-digit PIN.

![POS Only Staff](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/bff58a13-e4e7-4a8a-a168-6e4d662a6f39.png)

You can tell them apart at a glance using the filters at the top of the page: **All staff**, **Web access** and **POS only**.

![User Management Filters](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/d89105b8-7c82-40af-8a2c-10ec11a11249.png)

---

## What each OrderHub role means

Everyone with a login gets one of two roles.

| Role | What it means |
| --- | --- |
| **Organization Admin** | Full run of the business. Adds and removes staff, sets roles, issues and resets PINs, turns Film App access on and off, and changes settings. |
| **Organization User** | Does the day-to-day work — orders, jobs, production, customers and messages — but cannot manage staff or change organisation settings. |

* Note: the staff controls described in this article (PINs, the Film App switch, POS Role) are only visible to an Organization Admin.

---

## What each POS Role means

If a person uses the till, they also get a **POS Role**. This is separate from their OrderHub role — it decides what they can do at the till.

| POS Role | At the till they can |
| --- | --- |
| **Counter Staff** | Sell, take payments and mark orders picked up. Can issue refunds below your refund threshold. |
| **Supervisor** | Everything Counter Staff can, plus apply discounts and void refunds. Can authorise a refund over the threshold by co-signing with a manager PIN. |
| **Manager** | Everything a Supervisor can, plus view session reports and close sessions at end of day. Co-signs refunds over the threshold. |

The refund threshold itself is set once for the business in your POS settings, not per person.

* Note: changing someone's POS Role applies at their next PIN sign-in at the till.

![POS Staff Detail](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/c77b915c-3ab9-45e4-aaea-29e24f209c54.png)

---

## Film App access

**Film App** is a separate switch on each staff card, for labs running the film development workflow. Turning it on lets that person sign in to the Film Development App on a film terminal with their PIN.

It is independent of till access:

* Someone can have Film App access without any till access at all.
* Turning off POS access leaves Film App access on, and they keep their PIN.
* A POS-only member of staff can be given Film App access too.

---

## Location

Each staff card shows a **Location**. Set this for anyone working in a specific shop or lab — it decides which site's work they are attributed to, and for labs with more than one processing site it controls which film rolls they are allowed to update.

---

## Choosing the right type

| The person… | Give them |
| --- | --- |
| Only serves customers at the counter | POS-only staff, Counter Staff |
| Runs the shop and closes the till at night | POS-only staff or a login, Manager |
| Works in the office on orders and jobs | OrderHub login, Organization User |
| Owns or runs the business | OrderHub login, Organization Admin |
| Works in the film room | Film App access on, with or without till access |

---

## Good to know

* A PIN only works at your own business's tills and film terminals.
* If you take away POS access, the person's history stays intact — nothing is deleted.
* **View Activity** on a staff card shows what that person has done.
* Deleting a member of staff is for people who have left. If someone is away or has just changed job, change their role or turn off access instead.
